def load_team_membership_csv(course, response):
    """
    Load a CSV detailing course membership.

    Arguments:
        course (CourseDescriptor): Course module for which CSV
            download has been requested.
        response (HttpResponse): Django response object to which
            the CSV content will be written.
    """
    # Implementation of CSV loading logic goes here
    import csv
    from django.http import HttpResponse

    # Prepare the CSV response
    response['Content-Disposition'] = 'attachment; filename="team_membership.csv"'
    response['Content-Type'] = 'text/csv'

    writer = csv.writer(response)
    writer.writerow(['Member ID', 'Member Name'])  # Example header

    # Example data, replace with actual data retrieval logic
    for member in course.get_team_members():
        writer.writerow([member.id, member.name])

    return response
